item.title: Chatt Prep’s Marquis Gardner Makes School History Signing With Navy
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Chatt Prep running back Marquis Gardner signed with Navy on National Signing Day, becoming the school’s first ever division-one signee. A Naval academy recruiter said Gardner is the first player to sign with their school from Chattanooga in the past 20 years. Gardner accounted for over 2,200 yards in his senior season.
